newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Gujarat Ambuja gains on results.
newsitem.headline: India's Gujarat Ambuja gains on results.

text.p: Shares of India's Gujarat Ambuja Cements rose 6.95 rupees or 2.3 percent to 316.50 on the National Stock Exchange (NSE) on Wednesday after the firm announced improved results for the financial year ended June 30, 1996.
The firm said on Tuesday its 1995/96 net rose 47 percent to 1,478.2 million rupees. It said growth would continue to be strong in the current financial year.
Traders said nearly 50,000 shares were traded in the first 25 minutes on the NSE.
The Bombay Stock Exchange is closed for a Hindu festival.
